Name: Extra Event Commands
Author: tsubasamoon
Description:
[center][size=6][b]Extra Event Commands[/b][/size]
[i]Expand your event scripting possibilities[/i][/center]

[line]

[size=5][b]Overview[/b][/size]

Extra Event Commands adds powerful new event commands to Stardew Valley, giving content creators more control over cutscenes and events. Rotate characters, display text bubbles over the farmer, adjust farmer transparency, change farmer sprites dynamically, and more!

[line][size=5][b]
Features

🔄 Character Rotation
[/b][/size][size=3]Rotate the farmer and NPCs to any angle during events - perfect for dramatic camera work, unique perspectives, or creative scene composition.
Commands:[/size][size=5][b]

[/b][/size][size=3][b]rotate[/b] [character] [degrees] - Rotate farmer or any NPC (e.g., rotate Farmer 180, rotate Penny 90)
[b]resetRotation[/b] [character] - Reset specific character's rotation
[b]rotateFarmer[/b] [degrees] - Backward compatible shorthand for rotating the farmer
[b]resetFarmerRotation[/b] - Backward compatible shorthand for resetting farmer rotation

Compatible with Fashion Sense! Works for both farmers and NPCs![/size][size=5][b]

👕 Clothing Control
[/b][/size][size=3]Toggle individual clothing items and accessories on/off during events - create wardrobe changes, reveal moments, or customize appearance for specific scenes.
Commands:[/size][size=5][b]

[/b][/size][size=3][b]stripClothing[/b] [items...] - Strip all clothing (no args) or specific items (shirt, pants, shoes, hat, sleeves, accessory)
[b]restoreClothing[/b] [items...] - Restore all or specific clothing items
[b]strip[/b] [items...] / wear [items...] - Short aliases with argument support
[b]stripAll / wearAll[/b] - Always strip/restore everything (ignores arguments)

Supported items: shirt, pants, shoes, hat, sleeves, accessory, accessory0, accessory1, accessory2
Full Fashion Sense compatibility with support for all 3 accessory slots!
[/size][size=5][b]
🎭 Custom Sprite Changing
[/b][/size][size=3]Change the farmer's appearance to any sprite sheet with automatic positioning of hair, accessories, and clothing layers - ideal for extending farmer poses with a custom farmer spritesheet, works similarly to the changeSprite command in the base game.
Commands:

[b]changeFarmerSprite[/b] [spriteName] - Switch to custom sprites (loads Characters/Farmer_[spriteName] and Characters/Farmer_[spriteName]_pants)
[b]resetFarmerSprite [/b]- Restore original appearance

Features:

Automatic hair/accessory positioning with intelligent offset calculation
Manual offset configuration via JSON for pixel-perfect positioning
Hot-reload config system for rapid iteration
Seamlessly integrates with default and Fashion Sense clothing system[/size][size=5][b]

📏 Layer Positioning
[/b][/size][size=3]Control whether the farmer renders in front of or behind NPCs - essential for proper visual storytelling and spatial relationships.
Commands:

[b]farmerAbove[/b] [npcName] - Render farmer in front of NPC
[b]farmerBelow[/b] [npcName] - Render farmer behind NPC
[b]resetLayers[/b] - Clear layer overrides

Fashion Sense compatible - all clothing layers follow farmer position[/size][size=5][b]

🎪 Temp Actor Layering
[/b][/size][size=3]Position temporary actors with precise control over their render order and screen placement - draw actors as UI overlays guaranteed to be on top of everything.
Commands:

[b]tempActorAtTile[/b] [actorName] [tileX] [tileY] - Position at map coordinates (moves with camera)
[b]tempActorAtScreen[/b] [actorName] [screenX] [screenY] - Fixed screen positioning (doesn't move with camera)
[b]resetTempActors[/b] - Clear all actor overrides

Automatically moves original actors off-screen to prevent double-drawing[/size][size=5][b]

💬 Text Bubbles
[/b][/size][size=3]Display text above the farmer's head, just like NPCs - perfect for reactions, thoughts, or dialogue.
Commands:

[b]farmerTextAboveHead[/b] \"text\" [style] [duration] [preTimer] - Show text bubble

style: 0 = shaking, 2 = normal (default: 2)
duration: milliseconds (default: 3000)
preTimer: delay in milliseconds (default: 0)
uses default if no style duration or preTimer argument


Examples:

[b]farmerTextAboveHead[/b] \"Hello!\" - Show "Hello!" for 3 seconds
[b]farmerTextAboveHead[/b] \"Watch out!\" 0 2000 - Shaking text for 2 seconds
[b]farmerTextAboveHead[/b] \"...\" 2 5000 1000 - Normal text for 5 seconds after 1 second delay

Automatically adjusts position when farmer is rotated[/size][size=5][b]

👻 Transparency Control
[/b][/size][size=3]Make the farmer semi-transparent or invisible - ideal for ghost effects, dream sequences, or stealth scenes.
Commands:

[b]farmerOpacity[/b] [0.0-1.0] - Set transparency (0 = invisible, 1 = fully visible)
[b]resetFarmerOpacity[/b] - Restore full visibility

Examples:

[b]farmerOpacity[/b] 0 - Completely invisible
[b]farmerOpacity[/b] 0.5 - 50% transparent
[b]farmerOpacity[/b] 0.3 - 70% transparent (30% visible)

Works with vanilla and Fashion Sense clothing[/size][size=5][b][size=3]
[/size][line]
[size=5][b]Configuration[/b][/size]
[/b][/size]
Sprite Offset ConfigurationFor custom farmer sprites, you can create [code]FarmerSpriteConfig*.json[/code] files in any mod folder with manual offset configurations for per-frame hair placement:
{
  "Sprites": {
    "[spriteName]": {
      "OffsetsMale": [[x, y], [x, y], ...],
      "OffsetsFemale": [[x, y], [x, y], ...]
    }
  }
}If no config files are in the Extra Event Commands mod folder, an example config will be created on game startup. The mod automatically scans all mod folders and merges configurations. If no manual offsets are provided, intelligent auto-calculation is used. The category "spriteName" follows the same format as the Farmer_[spriteName] used in the content pack used to load your custom farmer sprite.
[size=5][size=3]
[/size][b][line]
